raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":498,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT ROUND(hk.total_mv / avg_ind.avg_mv, 2) AS ratio FROM (SELECT s.current_price * s.total_shares AS total_mv FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_name = '海康威视' LIMIT 1) hk CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(s2.current_price * s2.total_shares) AS avg_mv FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id WHERE c2.industry_code = (SELECT c3.industry_code FROM finance_tax.companies c3 WHERE c3.company_name = '海康威视' LIMIT 1)) avg_ind;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"计算海康威视2025年总市值","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.stocks","MYSQL:finance_tax.companies"],"columns":["current_price","total_shares","company_name"]},{"requirement":"计算海康威视所属行业的平均总市值","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.stocks","MYSQL:finance_tax.companies"],"columns":["current_price","total_shares","industry_code"]},{"requirement":"计算海康威视总市值是行业平均市值的倍数","tables":[],"columns":[]}],"assumptions":["2025年总市值使用stocks表中最新股价current_price与总股本total_shares的乘积近似计算，未使用stock_daily_trades按2025年交易日筛选","行业平均市值按海康威视所属industry_code下所有公司计算，未额外限定A股等市场分类"]}
